headline: Exchange Inflows Fell To 1,250.6 Million Dollars From 1,752.6 Million
narrative: The 24-hour exchange inflow fell to 1,250.6 million dollars, 0.4638 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, from 1,752.6 million dollars at 0.6551 percent. Binance took in 1,215.6 million dollars of the 1,250.6 million dollar intake. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means money arrived where holders can sell, and Bitget moved the other way, with 50.7 million dollars leaving that venue.
author: jordan
